Labor Force Participation Rate by Sex, Age, and Marital Status

labor_force_marital.Rd

A curated dataset derived from International Labour Organization (ILOSTAT) database (Indicator: EAP_DWAP_SEX_AGE_MTS_RT_A). Contains annual labor force participation rates in percent across countries, broken down by sex, aggregate age groups, and aggregate marital status categories from 2015.

Usage

labor_force_marital

Format

A tibble with 8 variables:

country

Character. Country or territory name.

survey_source

Character. Name of the underlying national household survey or census.

sex

Character. Sex category ("Male", "Female", "Other").

age_group

Character. Aggregate age band (e.g., "15–24", "25–54", "55–64"). Note: '15+' represents the total aggregate working-age population.

marital_status

Character. Aggregated marital status ("Married / Union / Cohabiting", "Single / Widowed / Divorced").

year

Numeric. Calendar year of the observation.

participation_rate

Numeric. Labour force participation rate in percent.

data_status

Character. Data quality flag or status (e.g., "Break in series", NA).

Source

International Labour Organization (ILOSTAT) database: Indicator EAP_DWAP_SEX_AGE_MTS_RT_A: https://ilostat.ilo.org/

Details

The raw ILOSTAT dataset was cleaned as follows:

  • Filtered for non-missing participation rates and excluded records flagged as "Unreliable".

  • Records flagged with "Break in series" (methodological updates to national household surveys) were retained to preserve longitudinal continuity.

  • Retained only aggregate age bands and aggregate marital status categories.

  • Removed non-specific aggregate categories including "Total" (for sex and marital status) and "Not elsewhere classified".

  • Stripped category label prefixes (e.g., "Age (Aggregate bands): ") for cleaner visual plotting.
